notes: Main article only; supplementary Figure 1S (Ni- and Co-modified CAs) is not in the input. PDF pages 1-2 are the LLNL report cover and disclaimer, page 5 is the web abstract. Own measurements: volumetric Sieverts, 77 K, adsorption isotherms to ~38 bar on undoped ACAs of 1460-3200 m2/g, plus a 330 m2/g non-carbonized organic aerogel and Ni/Co-doped carbon aerogels (970-1100 m2/g). Paper says 'We also report, for the first time, the surface area dependence of hydrogen surface excess sorption isotherms of carbon aerogels at 77 K', so duplicate_data does not apply. Primary research communication, not a review. record.json is_retracted is false and the PDF carries no retraction notice.
